body_html:
Give any workspace the flexibility staff actually use. The Newland 48"x24" height-adjustable table moves smoothly from sitting to standing on a dual-motor electric base, pairing clean, modular lines with the durability institutional offices, training rooms, and open-plan layouts demand. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group, it brings ergonomic adjustability to private offices and shared work areas alike.

Features

  • Electric 3-stage base adjusts from 22.6" to 48.2" high for true sit-to-stand work
  • Dual-motor lift with a 265 lb capacity, moving at 1.2" per second at a quiet 42 dB
  • Up-down controller with digital read-out and four programmable memory positions
  • Anti-collision sensor protects people and equipment
  • Quick-assembly base with pre-assembled leg columns and telescopic cross bar — ships flat in 2 cartons
  • Laminate worksurface available in all Newland finishes; base in Black, Designer White, or Tungsten
  • 0.1W standby draw and an 8' power cord for efficient, flexible placement

Specifications

Overall 46"W x 23"D with a 1" laminate top. Meets applicable ANSI/BIFMA X5.5 standards and is ETL/cETL and GREENGUARD Gold certified. Laminate tops carry a 15-year warranty, with 5 years on moving and electrical parts. Tops and bases may be ordered separately.

Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Canadian dealer (296 George St N, Peterborough ON) and an OECM-eligible supplier, so Ontario institutional buyers can purchase without an open tender. Request a Quote below or call 1-800-835-9565 to spec your configuration.
